prompts: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one finished 16:9 wide 1920x1080 educational video cutaway for capable 16-year-olds about human-directed AI research. Refined dimensional scientific illustration, bright white / very pale lavender background, deep navy typography, teal glass and metallic realistic computing objects. NOT a course slide with title header or cards. A single connected left-to-right workflow made of four visually rich, distinct objects: a human-set goal represented by a realistic checklist and pen, a small neural computing module paired with a code editor, a laboratory experiment represented by laboratory glass plus a compact chart of results, and a human verification checkpoint represented by a hand using a magnifying glass over the result. Clean thin arrows connect the four stages once left to right, NO feedback loop. Minimal exact text under the objects: 'Human sets goal', 'AI writes code', 'Experiments + results', 'Human verifies'. Place all objects and text in central 84 percent of image with ample whitespace and readable large text at 720p. Mature, precise, tactile three-dimensional materials, clean studio lighting. No additional words, no branding, no percentages, no tiny invented code, no robots, no person faces. The teaching point is AI can help run research but people direct and verify it.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create one finished 16:9 wide 1920x1080 educational video cutaway contrasting human-directed AI tools with hypothetical autonomous self-improvement. Bright white / pale lavender stage, refined 3D scientific illustration with realistic metallic and translucent computational modules, deep navy large typography, teal left and restrained violet right. NO course board styling, no rounded cards, no header banner. Two spacious visual groups separated by whitespace, no arrow between groups. Left: human hand at a laptop keyboard, the screen shows an abstract code editor with a small assistant spark; adjacent a human verification check. Exact text above left group: 'Human-directed'. Exact text below left group: 'Happening today'. Right: three successive translucent neural computing modules connected by a circular loop of thin dashed arrows, one question mark in center. Exact text above right group: 'Self-improving loop'. Exact text below right group: 'Hypothetical'. Keep all elements inside central 84 percent and labels large enough to read at 720p. The right loop is a proposal, not current fact. Neither diagram shows a timeline or numerical capability measurement. No extra words, percentages, brands, cartoon characters or people faces. Sophisticated mature scientific editorial art.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create one finished 16:9 wide 1920x1080 conceptual educational video cutaway about hypothetical artificial superintelligence. Mature high-quality 3D scientific editorial illustration on bright white / very pale lavender studio background. Center: a translucent rose-red neural computing module with a large elegant question mark floating in its center. Around it, a balanced constellation of five distinct realistic objects symbolizing cognitive work: mathematical notation on a small slate with no readable equation, a code-editor laptop without legible code, molecular model, an architectural design model, a chess knight. Thin dotted connections go from central module outward, without a timeline, ascending ladder, bar chart or growth curve. Exact large heading near top: 'HYPOTHETICAL'. Exact readable line near bottom: 'Beyond the best humans across nearly every cognitive field'. Keep all content in central 84 percent of frame so no elements crop at 720p; generous whitespace, deep navy text, professional dimensional lighting, restrained rose-red and purple accents. This image represents a possibility, not a current achievement. No dates, no numbers, no statistics, no other text, no logos, no robots, no faces, no pictures of real people.
